about_the_game:
inZOI: Island Getaway is inZOI's first official DLC. Swim and snorkel in Cahaya's crystal-clear waters, where vibrant coral reefs, sea turtles, and dolphins await. Unwind at a resort with a variety of relaxing and recreational activities.
But remember: life on this dazzling resort island comes with its share of hard work. Each day here consists of a constant cycle of labor and leisure.

Key Features

  • New City: Cahaya — Cahaya is comprised of three islands: the main island, where Zois can earn a living through farming, gathering, or fishing; the resort island, which offers both recreation and relaxation; and the deserted island, a mysterious place nestled between these two islands. Form new families or immigrate to Cahaya with an existing family.

  • Farming and Crafting — Farm crops, mine minerals and gemstones for cutting, and catch a wide range of fish across Cahaya and other cities. Turn a profit with resources harvested from these activities by selling them, crafting them into items for other Zois, or delivering them to the Corner Store. The weather in Cahaya can be unpredictable, so make sure to be prepared for sudden heatwaves or heavy rain.

  • Relaxing at the Resort — The resort island offers a wide range of leisure spots for you to unwind at. Enjoy a swim in the pool or explore underwater worlds at scenic snorkeling spots. Refresh your body and mind at the Massage Zone with massages, catered food, and relaxing sauna sessions. Also, don't forget to visit the nearby temple to pay your respects to Cahaya's guardian cats.

  • Resort Activities — A variety of events and activities await you at the resort. Collect Resort Coins and trade them in for special rewards. Try checking out different events held on different days of the week, from simple arcade games to resort-exclusive events like lucky draws, treasure hunts, and Turtlebot races. And of course, be sure not to miss the pool parties!
